title: Help
intro: If you or anyone in your family is in danger, or you're worried about a child's safety, please contact someone now. You don't have to handle this alone.

contacts.label: Fundación ANAR: family and schools line
contacts.note: Free advice for adults worried about a child or teenager. 24/7, confidential.

contacts.label: Fundación ANAR: children and teens
contacts.note: For children and teenagers themselves. Free, 24/7, confidential.

professional_help: If you're worried about your child's development, attention or behaviour, talk to your paediatrician (pediatra) or the school's counsellor. They can help you decide whether further support is needed.
about_this_app: This coach shares general, evidence-informed parenting skills. It is not therapy, it doesn't diagnose anything, and it doesn't replace professional help.
exclusions: This coach is not suitable if there is violence at home, if a child is at risk of harm, or if you are in crisis yourself. Please use the contacts above instead.
verify_note: Numbers checked 21 Nov 2026 via web search. Re-check before each release.
